focus_areas: Legibility of text on the background heart decoration (critical AI artifact indicator).
Geometric precision of the puck's edge (confirmation of missing ridges).
Surface texture realism of the puck (avoidance of plastic/smooth AI sheen).
Spatial grounding and shadow contact of the puck on the surface.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Prioritize the analysis of the text on the red heart; if it is gibberish, this is a strong indicator of AI generation regardless of the puck's appearance. For the puck, focus on the edge: real pucks have distinct horizontal ridges. The absence of these ridges is a significant deviation from the ground truth taxonomy. Determine if this is a 'generic black disk' failure mode common in AI generation. Also, scrutinize the shadow contact point for any floating or bleeding artifacts.
image_description: A black, cylindrical object resembling a hockey puck sits in the foreground on a white surface. In the background, a red heart-shaped decoration hangs on a textured wall, featuring a dark central area with illegible text-like markings. A dried rose stem lies horizontally to the left of the puck.
